contracts: markInternalDepth checks every descriptor through reverse references; multi-entity cycles and depth beyond 20 produce DomainGraphException with actual XML attribute paths. Immediate self references are skipped by the depth traversal.
rustGeneratedBootstrap iterates constant descriptors in their actual domain order, after the ordinary root; it does not topologically reorder constant writes.
rustTypedConstantValue assigns object-reference bootstrap fields 1_u64 regardless of explicit _value reference data.

Original optional constant-reference identity helpers compare Option<u64> with u64; complete optional-self and optional-forward crates each fail with two E0308 errors. Native complete umbrellas independently compile; these are not paired runtime oracles.
